literal: Official Posts Treatise, Part Four
idiomatic: Official Posts Treatise IV

literal: ○ Southern Face, inferior ○ Southern Face capital officials
idiomatic: ○ Southern Face — inferior Southern Face capital officials

literal: Liao had five capitals.
idiomatic: Liao maintained five capitals.

literal: Shangjing was the imperial capital; all court officials and capital officials were found there;
idiomatic: Shangjing served as the imperial capital, with the full range of court and capital posts;

literal: The other four capitals set offices as suited, with institutions not uniform.
idiomatic: The other four capitals appointed offices as needed, under varying schemes.

literal: Broadly speaking, Xijing had many frontier-defense offices; Nanjing and Zhongjing had many fiscal-revenue offices.
idiomatic: Generally Xijing emphasized frontier posts, while Nanjing and Zhongjing emphasized fiscal posts.

literal: Those established in all five capitals are listed together;
idiomatic: Posts found in all five capitals are listed together;

literal: Those specially established are listed separately below.
idiomatic: Capital-specific posts appear in separate sections below.
